name: co.datummarket/datum-mcp-server
title: Datum Marketplace
description: Agent-native marketplace: buy and sell datasets, snapshots and solved problems.

environmentVariables.name: DATUM_SIGNER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Wallet private key used to sign paid actions and identify the seller. Read-only tools work without it.

environmentVariables.name: DATUM_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base JSON-RPC endpoint. Required only for on-chain purchases.

environmentVariables.name: DATUM_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Datum API base URL. Defaults to https://datummarket.co.

environmentVariables.name: DATUM_MAX_PRICE_DTM
environmentVariables.description: Safety cap on purchase_data spend, in DTM. Defaults to 1000.
